title: studio(landing): a read-only package offers no way to start a writable copy — BuilderLanding comments disagree on whether Duplicate applies to read-only packages
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## Maintainer quick-read

The Studio landing lists installed packages as "Read-only · browsable" with no way to start a writable copy. Offer one?

## Seen

`BuilderLanding` carries two comments that disagree: one says a read-only code package is "a STARTING POINT, not a dead end — duplicate re-namespaces it into a new writable base"; the one above the Duplicate button says duplicate "only makes sense for writable bases … customizing a code package goes through templates / marketplace install". The button renders for writable packages only.

## Options

- **A** — *Customize a copy* on read-only cards (server-side duplicate into a new namespace).
- **B** — keep it writable-only and fix the comment; point read-only cards at the marketplace/template route.
- **C** — status quo.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *read-only package duplicate writable copy studio landing customize*: 8 hits (0 open, 8 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *BuilderLanding duplicate package action hidden for code-defined read-only package*: 5 hits (0 open, 5 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#5987 (closed) — clone-to-customize precedent for read-only content, per item not per package
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#2259 (closed) — read-only package handling family
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: read-only package duplicate writable copy · studio landing customize copy
